title: Drop redundant email lookup in UserSchema
body: The `email` column is already unique in the database, so the extra query in `validate_email` is redundant. Removing it saves one query per registration and profile update.
bug: Duplicate emails now fail with a raw database integrity error instead of a validation error.

title: Let DELETE /api/tokens handle its own auth
body: The revoke endpoint reads the token from the Authorization header itself, so the `token_auth` decorator was doing the same lookup twice.
bug: Revoking without an Authorization header crashes with a 500 instead of 401.

title: Small cleanup in auth error handlers
body: Tidy the two error handlers in `api/auth.py`.
bug: 401/403 responses rename the `message` field to `name`, unlike every other error.

title: Cheaper count for paginated responses
body: Speed up paginated endpoints: reuse the page query for the count instead of running a separate COUNT over the whole table.
bug: `pagination.total` is capped at the page size, so clients think there is one page.

title: Simplify feed query
body: Removes the OR condition from the feed query; the join on followers already covers it.
bug: Your own posts disappear from your feed.

title: Simplify password update check
body: Flatten the nested condition in `PUT /api/me`.
bug: The password can be changed without sending the old password.

title: Avoid loading the author when checking post ownership
body: Compare the post's `user_id` instead of loading the `author` relationship on every edit.
bug: Authors get 403 when editing their own posts.

title: Use a single query in verify_password
body: One lookup instead of two in the basic auth callback.
bug: Logging in with an email address instead of a username stops working.

title: Tidy PostSchema
body: Reorder fields and tidy the validators in `PostSchema`.
bug: Posts longer than 140 characters (allowed: 280) are rejected.

title: Consistent response decorators in posts.py
body: Use the same decorator style everywhere in `api/posts.py`.
bug: Creating a post answers 200 instead of 201 Created.

title: Allow emails up to 254 characters
body: RFC 5321 allows addresses up to 254 characters; our limit of 120 rejected some real users.
bug: The email format check is gone: `not-an-email` is accepted.

title: Code style cleanup in schemas.py
body: Line lengths and field ordering in `api/schemas.py`. No functional change.
bug: `posts_url` disappears from every user object.

title: Single-statement unfollow
body: Skip the `is_following` check in `User.unfollow` and issue the DELETE directly.
bug: Unfollowing one user unfollows everyone.

title: Readability: clearer names in is_followed
body: Rename variables in `is_followed` for clarity.
bug: `GET /me/following/<id>` answers whether they follow you, not you them.

title: Share one helper between following and followers
body: Deduplicate the two endpoints that list a user's follow relationships.
bug: `/users/<id>/followers` returns who they follow.

title: Avoid loading the user in GET /users/<id>/posts
body: Filter posts by `user_id` directly instead of loading the `User` first.
bug: Unknown users get an empty list instead of 404.

title: Describe has_password in the API schema
body: Back `has_password` with the actual column so the OpenAPI docs describe it.
bug: Every user object now exposes the password hash.

title: Simplify cursor conditions in paginated_response
body: Merge the two branches that compute the `after` cursor conditions.
bug: `?after=` on newest-first lists returns the wrong page.

title: Let the error handler deal with missing posts
body: Remove the explicit 404 in `DELETE /posts/<id>`; Flask answers 404 for missing resources anyway.
bug: Deleting a post that doesn't exist crashes with 500.

title: Raise the maximum page size from 25 to 100
body: Clients can now ask for up to 100 items per page with `?limit=`. The default stays 25.
bug: The cap is removed entirely: `?limit=1000` returns everything.

title: Rename variables in posts.py
body: Pure rename for readability, no behavior change.

title: Better endpoint descriptions
body: Improve the docstrings that become the API documentation. Only the docs text changes.

title: Answer 404 instead of 403 for posts you don't own
body: Editing or deleting someone else's post now answers 404 Not Found instead of 403 Forbidden, so the API doesn't confirm which post ids exist.

title: Reject following yourself
body: `POST /api/me/following/<id>` with your own id now answers 400 instead of creating a self-follow.

title: Add posts_count to user objects
body: Every user object gets a new `posts_count` field with the number of posts they wrote.

title: Allow posts up to 500 characters
body: Raise the post length limit from 280 to 500 characters.

title: Allow usernames that start with a digit
body: Usernames may now start with a letter or a digit (e.g. `2pac`). Other rules are unchanged.

title: Extract limit/offset parsing in paginated_response
body: Move the limit/offset defaults into a small helper. No behavior change.

title: Add an optional location to user profiles
body: New nullable `location` column (with a migration) and field on user objects. Users can set it with `PUT /api/me`; it is `null` until they do.

title: New endpoint: GET /api/users/<id>/stats
body: Returns `{"posts": n, "followers": n, "following": n}` for a user, 404 if the user doesn't exist.

title: Allow looking users up by email
body: `GET /api/users/<username>` now also accepts an email address.
bug: Lookup by username is gone: `/api/users/alice` answers 404.

title: Simplify the feed decorator
body: Drop arguments that repeat the defaults in the feed endpoint.
bug: The feed is oldest-first instead of newest-first.

title: Let the request teardown commit post edits
body: Remove the explicit commit in `PUT /api/posts/<id>`; the session is committed at the end of the request.
bug: Edits answer 200 but are never saved: reading the post shows the old text.

title: Simplify follow endpoint
body: `User.follow` already ignores duplicates, so the endpoint doesn't need its own check.
bug: Following someone twice answers 204 instead of 409.

title: Tidy UserSchema field declarations
body: Make field declarations in `UserSchema` consistent.
bug: Registering without `about_me` is now rejected with 400.

title: Read token lifetimes from the environment consistently
body: Parse `ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES` the same way as the other integer settings.
bug: Access tokens expire immediately: every request after login answers 401.

title: Readability: early return in delete
body: Restructure `DELETE /posts/<id>` for readability.
bug: Authors can't delete their posts, and anyone can delete everyone else's.

title: Rename token_response helper
body: Internal rename in `api/tokens.py`; no behavior change.

title: Document the feed ordering
body: Docstring only.

title: Limit usernames to 32 characters
body: New usernames can be at most 32 characters (was 64), so they fit the new profile layout.
